resources.string: Budget, pricing and spending on this device

Transcription on this installation only, billed in USD. Other devices, other apps and refinement are outside this budget. Folder rules and accounting stay here, including when restoring a notes backup.
An interrupted request may have been charged. Its reservation stays until a cost arrives or you reconcile it, including into the next period.
Price or billing unit cannot be verified: unknown cost.
Price has expired: refresh it before using a spending limit.
Per million tokens: input %1$s to %2$s, output up to %3$s. Duration alone cannot predict the total.
%1$s to %2$s per minute, depending on the provider selected by OpenRouter.
Status unavailable. Save an OpenRouter key and refresh.
Pampa stops new uploads using verified prices and reservations. Final costs may vary; OpenRouter applies its own limits and rules to requests in progress. Audio already sent cannot be recalled.
Use my estimate for the selected model
With a limit enabled, token, expired or unknown prices block uploads. Your own rate is also an estimate, never a guaranteed maximum. This also applies to Groq without verified pricing.
USD amount; decimal comma accepted, up to 6 decimal places.
Enter a nonnegative amount with up to 6 decimal places.
Check the request with the service and enter its actual charge. Explicitly confirm zero for an uncharged request. Nothing here changes provider billing.
Record %1$s for this request and replace its reservation? Provider billing stays unchanged.
Local totals start again from now. Reservations and uncertain charges remain; history is retained. Provider charges are not refunded and provider limits do not change.
Cloud controls could not be read or saved. No new upload is authorized.
Applies here and in subfolders to all cloud services. Your home computer remains available. The nearest explicit folder rule wins.
Currently blocked by “Home computer only”, which overrides every folder.
Folder hierarchy unavailable: cloud uploads blocked.
Model identifier; leave empty to inherit. Does not change the selected service.
A change stops the next cloud upload, including queued jobs. It cannot recall audio already transmitted.
This folder does not allow cloud transcription. Check its cloud permissions.
Transcription is restricted to your home computer.
The next upload exceeds the available local budget. Check costs and reservations.
The next upload exceeds the predicted limit for this transcription.
These controls need current, verifiable duration pricing. Refresh prices or review your cost options.
Some requests have an unknown charge. Reconcile them before using a spending limit.
This request is still in progress. Wait until it finishes before reconciling it.
The folder model changed during this job. Retry to use the new selection.
The service key changed. Retry to use the current key.
Your estimate: %1$s; the actual charge may differ.
The estimate covers the first upload. Overlapping chunks and retries can increase spending; completed chunks are not uploaded again.
Estimate unavailable. Controls will still be checked before every upload.
